data.gender_notes: Iosep is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Iosep means 'God will add'. This name was borne by two significant figures in the Bible: Joseph, the son of Jacob, and Joseph of Arimathea, who provided Jesus with a burial place. The name Iosep carries the meaning “God will add” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Iosep usually hope their child will grow to embody god will add and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: יוסף
in_hebrew.meaning: הוא יוסף אלוהים יוסיף לו עוד בן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוסף הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים יוסיף לו עוד בן' או 'הוא יוסף אלוהים יוסיף לו עוד בן'. השם נגזר מהשורש י-ס-פ שפירושו 'להוסיף' והוא קשור לנושא של הוספת בן נוסף למשפחה. השם יוסף מופיע בתנ'ך כשהוא נושא שם זה, אחד מבני יעקב.

in_greek.name: Ιώσηπος
in_greek.meaning: ο Θεός προσθέσει γι' αυτόν άλλον υιόν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιώσηπος είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος יוסף (יוסף), που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός προσθέσει γι' αυτόν άλλον υιόν' ή 'αυτός που ο Θεός προσθέσει'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ιώσηπος αναφέρεται σε αρκετά πρόσωπα, συμπεριλαμβανομένου του Ιώσηπου, του συζύγου της Μαρίας, της μητέρας του Ιησού.

in_latin.name: Iosep
in_latin.meaning: Deus addet, or God shall add
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Iosep is derived from the Hebrew name יוסף (Yosef), which means 'Deus addet' or 'God shall add'. This name is significant in Christian tradition as it reflects the biblical narrative of Joseph, a key figure in the book of Genesis. The name's meaning is tied to the idea of addition or increase, often interpreted as a blessing from God.

in_english.name: Iosep
in_english.meaning: God will add, increase, or multiply
in_english.long_meaning: The name Iosep, a variant of Joseph, originates from the Hebrew name יוסף (Yosef), meaning 'God will add, increase, or multiply'. This name is deeply rooted in biblical history, as Joseph was a significant figure in the book of Genesis, known for his coat of many colors and his rise to prominence in Egypt. The name carries spiritual significance, symbolizing divine favor and providence. In Christian tradition, the name Iosep/Joseph is associated with virtues such as faithfulness, integrity, and perseverance.
